Terms and Conditions of Use Policy for Hippocrates Wellness

Updated August 13, 2024

Welcome

Welcome to Hippocrates Wellness’s website and online services (“Hippocrates Wellness Site” or the “Site”), an online information and communications service provided by Hippocrates Wellness in Florida (“Hippocrates Wellness” or “We” or “Us”). This policy is intended to cover the uses for the entire Site, although additional conditions, restrictions, and privacy policies may apply.

Modification of These Terms of Use

Hippocrates Wellness reserves the right to change the terms, conditions, and notices under which the Hippocrates Wellness Site is offered, including but not limited to the charges associated with the use of the Hippocrates Wellness Site.

Reservation and Balances

• A 50% deposit is required to secure your reservation.

• Any balance remaining on your account will be charged to the credit card on file 21 days prior to your arrival date, unless another valid payment method is provided. If the new payment method is not valid, the initial card will be used.

• A $250 preauthorization will be placed on your card on file 7 days before the start of your reservation to ensure we have an active payment method when you arrive.

No Refund Policy

No portion of your expenses is refundable or can be charged back, regardless of the circumstances, including family events, personal health emergencies, and death. Instead, a house credit will be issued and remain active for one year from the date of the original reservation. After this period, the associated funds will expire.

House Credit Policy

• If you cancel your reservation, change dates, or leave Hippocrates Wellness before your scheduled departure, a dollar value will be issued as a house credit for any full week(s) not attended. No credits are issued for partial weeks.

• Hippocrates Wellness reserves the right to update pricing at any time, and you are only guaranteed a rate that is active during the time you choose to book your reservation.

• House credits are transferable to a family member or friend if you are unable to attend the program. House credits can be used anywhere at Hippocrates Wellness, including the store, spa, salon, and for meals.

By making a reservation with Hippocrates Wellness, you confirm that you understand and accept these terms.

Health Care Disclaimer

The content, products, and services offered herein are designed to educate consumers on health care and medical issues that may affect their daily lives. Nothing in the content, products, or services should be considered, or used as a substitute for, medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. This site and its services do not constitute the practice of any medical, nursing, or other professional health care advice, diagnosis, or treatment. You should always talk to your health care provider for diagnosis and treatment, including your specific medical needs. None of the products or services offered through this website represent or warrant that any particular service or product is safe, appropriate, or effective for you. We advise users to always seek the advice of a physician or other qualified health care provider with any questions regarding personal health or medical conditions. If you have or suspect that you have a medical problem or condition, please contact a qualified health care professional immediately. If you are in the United States and are experiencing a medical emergency, please call 911 or call for emergency medical help on the nearest telephone.
